questions.question: A rectangle on grid paper is 5 squares long and 3 squares wide. Find its area and explain.
questions.expected_answer: There are 3 rows with 5 squares in each, so 3 times 5 is 15. The area is 15 square units.

questions.question: A triangle covers 6 whole squares and 4 half squares. What is its area?
questions.expected_answer: The 4 half squares make 2 whole squares. 6 plus 2 is 8, so the area is 8 square units.

questions.question: A 4 by 3 rectangle and a 6 by 2 rectangle both have an area of 12 square units. Do they have the same perimeter? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: No. The 4 by 3 rectangle has a perimeter of 4 plus 3 plus 4 plus 3, which is 14 units. The 6 by 2 rectangle has 6 plus 2 plus 6 plus 2, which is 16 units.
